subject: general
question: Gaurav starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards the South. He then takes a left turn, drives 7 km, then turns left and drives 14 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km, and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Gaurav starts at Point A

11 km South

7 km West (left from South)

14 km North

11 km East

3 km South

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf6e57c8f3d9f9860bfe74fb08279ddd4a629a271425e6ad8e0d1509169b4125.png] 

So, To return from P to A: Move 4 km East

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
